message.content: {"summary":"Time Loop is implemented as a Godot 4 project that builds and launches cleanly, with title, chapter menu, and scenario-driven level play observed in current build and player runtime evidence. Core temporal mechanics (flash/rewind, ghost re-creation, timer countdown, timeline node presence) are partially observed, but most gameplay-dependent requirements lack runtime coverage, several acceptance criteria conflict with or overstate the original instruction (ghost count vs 'four loops', enemy distraction not in instruction's short-scope check, scenario determinism contradicted by title-clock replay mismatch), and demo trace packaging, final art, and replay-determinism for the normal path are unverified. The game is not delivery-ready.","instruction_audit":"Two designer/spec overstatements relative to the original: (a) R013/R014/R004/R006 criteria interpret 'layer up to four loops' as 'at most four active ghost instances' and 'four-loop orchestrations', while the implementation records at most three ghosts plus the current loop; the instruction never fixes the ghost-instance count, so the criterion 'no more than four active ghost instances' is a designer interpretation, not an instruction mandate, yet it also does not verify the ladder to four loops shown in the evidence. (b) The evaluation-asymptotic omission: the instruction requires '1-10 input-trace files' shipped in demo_outputs and deterministic fresh-launch replay, but the current package has no developer-owned demo_outputs traces (player traces live outside the game package), so R025/R026/R027/R031/R032/R033/R034/R035/R036 are unimplemented and R028/R037 fail on the observed title_nav_probe pixel/state divergence at frame 0. Also note the instruction's own scope omits an enemy distraction requirement from the short vision summary in 'What the Player Experiences', so R003's 'distract enemies' derives from the earlier prose and remains valid, but its acceptance is untested.","criteria":[{"requirement_id":"R001","criterion_index":0,"verdict":"pass","basis":"runtime","rationale":"In snapshot:near_rewind_probe-capture:0 and near_victory_probe-capture:0, TimerLabel reads '30.00' and tick begins 0 in Main/Level; ordinary entry into level was not directly observed but scenario entry (which bypasses menus) shows the initialized 30 s countdown.","evidence_ids":["player-0001-play-04"],"source_ids":["snapshot:near_rewind_probe-capture:0","snapshot:near_victory_probe-capture:0"]},{"requirement_id":"R001","criterion_index":1,"verdict":"insufficient","basis":"runtime","rationale":"No full 30 s expiry was observed in a single session: near_rewind jumped to tick 720 via debug_seek and then to tick 0 before 30 s could elapse. Exact 30.0 s expiry at the configured 30 Hz simulation rate is not demonstrated.","evidence_ids":[],"source_ids":["snapshot:near_rewind_probe-capture:180","file:37"]},{"requirement_id":"R001","criterion_index":2,"verdict":"insufficient","basis":"static","rationale":"Level.gd defines LOOP_SECONDS 30.0 / TICKS_PER_LOOP 900 shared via one script, and LevelData.build uses the same LOOP constant implicitly; however runtime evidence only covers level 1, not all 24 levels. Static sharing is plausible but runtime coverage for all 24 is absent.","evidence_ids":[],"source_ids":["file:37","file:39"]},{"requirement_id":"R002","criterion_index":0,"verdict":"pass","basis":"runtime","rationale":"At frame 180 in near_rewind the player node returns to position [96,480] (spawn), tick resets to 0, and flashing=true with flash_timer ~0.333, consistent with rewind-to-spawn at loop expiry.","evidence_ids":["player-0001-play-04"],"source_ids":["snapshot:near_rewind_probe-capture:180"]},{"requirement_id":"R002","criterion_index":1,"verdict":"insufficient","basis":"runtime","rationale":"A new ghost Area2D (@Area2D@16) appears and existing ghosts reset to playback_frame 0, but this was triggered by scenario debug_seek plus expiry; no observed frame shows capture-then-expiry creation from a genuine first loop. Whether the ghost starts at spawn/t=0 in the ordinary case is inferred.","evidence_ids":[],"source_ids":["snapshot:near_rewind_probe-capture:180","file:37"]},{"requirement_id":"R002","criterion_index":2,"verdict":"insufficient","basis":"runtime","rationale":"Ghost positions do advance with tick, but no comparison of recorded-state frames to ghost playback was inspected frame-by-frame; the recorded samples come from debug synthetic streams, not the player's actual loop.","evidence_ids":[],"source_ids":["snapshot:near_rewind_probe-capture:240","file:33"]},{"requirement_id":"R003","criterion_index":0,"verdict":"insufficient","basis":"runtime","rationale":"No runtime evidence exercises ghost occupancy of a switch or plate; allowed evidence for R003 is empty. The _resolve_holders code exists but is untested in current sessions.","evidence_ids":[],"source_ids":["file:37"]},{"requirement_id":"R003","criterion_index":1,"verdict":"insufficient","basis":"runtime","rationale":"Enemy distraction has no runtime evidence in allowed set; no session reached a level with enemies (only Chapter 1 levels observed).","evidence_ids":[],"source_ids":["file:37"]},{"requirement_id":"R003","criterion_index":2,"verdict":"insufficient","basis":"runtime","rationale":"Concurrent ghost+player interaction was not exercised; levels in evidence have no ghosts overlapping switches concurrently in observed snapshots.","evidence_ids":[],"source_ids":["snapshot:near_rewind_probe-capture:240"]},{"requirement_id":"R004","criterion_index":0,"verdict":"insufficient","basis":"runtime","rationale":"No authored level was demonstrated requiring two prior ghosts; LevelData.build only differentiates by chapter threshold and gives no evidence that a specific level cannot be solved without two ghosts.","evidence_ids":[],"source_ids":["file:39"]},{"requirement_id":"R004","criterion_index":1,"verdict":"insufficient","basis":"runtime","rationale":"No test removes a ghost contribution and confirms exit unreachability; exit gating is only tested via debug_hold_all_switches.","evidence_ids":[],"source_ids":["file:37","file:39"]},{"requirement_id":"R004","criterion_index":2,"verdict":"insufficient","basis":"runtime","rationale":"Ghost persistence across loops was only seen via scenarios and no verification of 'until reset or maximum loop limit'. Also, the max is 3 ghosts per MAX_RECORDED_GHOSTS, so the fourth ghost case is not observed.","evidence_ids":[],"source_ids":["snapshot:near_rewind_probe-capture:240","file:37"]},{"requirement_id":"R005","criterion_index":0,"verdict":"insufficient","basis":"runtime","rationale":"No level demonstrated as impossible in a single loop; LevelData.build levels appear solvable with one body on the required switch plus a dash to the exit in some cases.","evidence_ids":[],"source_ids":["file:39"]},{"requirement_id":"R005","criterion_index":1,"verdict":"insufficient","basis":"runtime","rationale":"No evidence of required time-scheduled distinct actions across loop iterations.","evidence_ids":[],"source_ids":["file:39"]},{"requirement_id":"R005","criterion_index":2,"verdict":"insufficient","basis":"runtime","rationale":"No evidence that earlier-loop ghost actions are necessary for later success; exit is completable via the current player holding the required switch.","evidence_ids":[],"source_ids":["file:39"]},{"requirement_id":"R006","criterion_index":0,"verdict":"pass","basis":"static","rationale":"LevelData.gd defines LEVEL_COUNT=24 and build(level_index) is called for level_index in [0,24); inventory shows the data file and scene used. Static project-file evidence supports exactly 24 defined levels.","evidence_ids":[],"source_ids":["file:39","build:build-0001"]},{"requirement_id":"R006","criterion_index":1,"verdict":"pass","basis":"static","rationale":"ChapterMenu.gd iterates CHAPTER_COUNT=4 with LEVELS_PER_CHAPTER=6, and runtime snapshot:title_nav_probe-capture:120 shows four chapter labels each with six level buttons.","evidence_ids":[],"source_ids":["file:31","snapshot:title_nav_probe-capture:120"]},{"requirement_id":"R006","criterion_index":2,"verdict":"insufficient","basis":"static","rationale":"max_ghosts() returns 1 for Ch1 and 3 for Ch2-4, so the 'final chapter requires four active loops' is implemented as three recorded ghosts + current loop; whether that qualifies as 'four-loop' is a designer interpretation, and no runtime evidence verifies Chapter 4 solves a four-loop puzzle.","evidence_ids":[],"source_ids":["file:39","instruction"]},{"requirement_id":"R007","criterion_index":0,"verdict":"insufficient","basis":"visual","rationale":"snapshot shows three HandA/HandB/HandC nodes at 640,340 but this text model has not visually inspected pixels; per protocol, visual criteria require insufficient plus follow-up inspection.","evidence_ids":[],"source_ids":["snapshot:probe:0","file:30"]},{"requirement_id":"R007","criterion_index":1,"verdict":"insufficient","basis":"visual","rationale":"Ghost silhouettes on the title screen are implied by title_backdrop asset; the text model has not visually confirmed silhouettes and the asset is a documented mock placeholder.","evidence_ids":[],"source_ids":["art-manifest","snapshot:probe:0"]},{"requirement_id":"R007","criterion_index":2,"verdict":"pass","basis":"runtime","rationale":"Ordinary launch sets current_screen=Main/TitleScreen and frame 120 shows navigation to Main/ChapterMenu only after Play click at (640,412). Title is first ordinary screen.","evidence_ids":["player-0001-play-01"],"source_ids":["snapshot:probe:0","snapshot:title_nav_probe-capture:120"]},{"requirement_id":"R008","criterion_index":0,"verdict":"pass","basis":"runtime","rationale":"snapshot:title_nav_probe-capture:120 shows four chapter labels (Amber, Teal, Magenta, Pale Gold).","evidence_ids":["player-0001-play-01"],"source_ids":["snapshot:title_nav_probe-capture:120"]},{"requirement_id":"R008","criterion_index":1,"verdict":"insufficient","basis":"runtime","rationale":"Grid shows 4 chapter headers and 24 level buttons, but many are pushed off-screen (x>1280, e.g. L3 button at 1286). Present in tree but not visible to the user; 'exposes six level entries' arguably means visible, not just present off-panel. Needs a visual/inspect follow-up.","evidence_ids":[],"source_ids":["snapshot:title_nav_probe-capture:120"]},{"requirement_id":"R008","criterion_index":2,"verdict":"pass","basis":"runtime","rationale":"Snapshot shows Level 1 enabled and all other 23 buttons disabled and labelled '(locked)', consistent with progression state after a fresh launch.","evidence_ids":["player-0001-play-01"],"source_ids":["snapshot:title_nav_probe-capture:120"]},{"requirement_id":"R009","criterion_index":0,"verdict":"insufficient","basis":"runtime","rationale":"Scenario near_rewind loads with tick 720 already set; the near_victory scenario loads with tick 360. Normal level-entry countdown start at 30.0 was never directly observed because title_nav_probe missed the Level 1 button.","evidence_ids":[],"source_ids":["snapshot:near_rewind_probe-capture:0","trace:title_nav_probe-capture"]},{"requirement_id":"R009","criterion_index":1,"verdict":"pass","basis":"runtime","rationale":"TimerLabel visible in a level runs from 30.00 down: near_victory shows 11.33 at frame 200 and 08.00 at frame 300.","evidence_ids":["player-0001-play-07"],"source_ids":["snapshot:near_victory_probe-capture:200","snapshot:near_victory_probe-capture:300"]},{"requirement_id":"R009","criterion_index":2,"verdict":"insufficient","basis":"runtime","rationale":"Normal-path countdown start not observed (only scenario launches); that the countdown starts only after scene ready in normal entry was not exercised.","evidence_ids":[],"source_ids":["trace:title_nav_probe-capture"]},{"requirement_id":"R010","criterion_index":0,"verdict":"insufficient","basis":"runtime","rationale":"Near-victory frame 200 shows player.position.x advancing from 96 to ~976 with velocity.x=220, so horizontal movement is observed. However, the R010 allowed evidence set contains no playthrough entry, and no evidence shows the input path from key_down events actually reaches Player (Player.gd reads Input.is_action_pressed while demo uses InputProxy which is a no-op). Reproducibility should be re-verified.","evidence_ids":[],"source_ids":["snapshot:near_victory_probe-capture:200","file:41","file:43"]},{"requirement_id":"R010","criterion_index":1,"verdict":"insufficient","basis":"runtime","rationale":"Jump: near_victory position y ~29004 at 450 and near_rewind y ~34033 at 599 show falling, but no snapshot directly confirms a grounded jump with JUMP_VELOCITY -420 versus a fall-off-platform. Unconfirmed grounded jump.","evidence_ids":[],"source_ids":["snapshot:near_victory_probe-capture:450","file:43"]},{"requirement_id":"R010","criterion_index":2,"verdict":"insufficient","basis":"runtime","rationale":"handle_interact() in Level.gd is 'pass' (no-op) and no runtime evidence shows a switch activated by a player interact key in a level other than via debug_hold_all_switches.","evidence_ids":[],"source_ids":["file:37"]},{"requirement_id":"R011","criterion_index":0,"verdict":"pass","basis":"runtime","rationale":"At near_rewind frame 180 the Level node has flashing=true and flash_timer~0.333; visible flash effect is wired to flash_rect color alpha. Observed state change is objective evidence that a visible flash state occurs at expiry.","evidence_ids":["player-0001-play-04"],"source_ids":["snapshot:near_rewind_probe-capture:180"]},{"requirement_id":"R011","criterion_index":1,"verdict":"pass","basis":"runtime","rationale":"At the same frame 180 the player returns to spawn (96,480) from an off-spawn position, and tick resets to 0.","evidence_ids":["player-0001-play-04"],"source_ids":["snapshot:near_rewind_probe-capture:180"]},{"requirement_id":"R011","criterion_index":2,"verdict":"insufficient","basis":"runtime","rationale":"Ghost node modulate is set to alpha 0.55 in Ghost.gd, but this text model has not visually confirmed a translucent render; per protocol, visual claims require visual inspection.","evidence_ids":[],"source_ids":["file:33"]},{"requirement_id":"R011","criterion_index":3,"verdict":"insufficient","basis":"runtime","rationale":"The ghost replays recorded debug samples, not a genuine prior player loop; no evidence shows the ghost reproducing a real prior loop's player state sequence. Allowed runtime evidence for R011 is near_rewind scenario, which uses debug_spawn_ghost_samples with synthetic pseudo-positions.","evidence_ids":[],"source_ids":["file:37","snapshot:near_rewind_probe-capture:240"]},{"requirement_id":"R012","criterion_index":0,"verdict":"insufficient","basis":"runtime","rationale":"Ghost-holding a button/switch has no runtime evidence in the allowed set; only code path via _resolve_holders.","evidence_ids":[],"source_ids":["file:37"]},{"requirement_id":"R012","criterion_index":1,"verdict":"insufficient","basis":"runtime","rationale":"No ghost-on-door observation; no door node exists in any observed level (near_rewind/near_victory level_def shows doors:[]).","evidence_ids":[],"source_ids":["snapshot:near_rewind_probe-capture:0"]},{"requirement_id":"R012","criterion_index":2,"verdict":"insufficient","basis":"runtime","rationale":"No laser node exists in observed level_def and beam truncation was not observed.","evidence_ids":[],"source_ids":["snapshot:near_rewind_probe-capture:0","file:37"]},{"requirement_id":"R013","criterion_index":0,"verdict":"insufficient","basis":"runtime","rationale":"MAX_RECORDED_GHOSTS=3 and _ghost_drop_oldest drops the oldest on overflow; the criterion constrains 'no more than four active ghosts' - a count that the implementation never reaches. Also, no evidence shows whether capping/recycling is the intended 'defined maximum-loop reset behavior'.","evidence_ids":[],"source_ids":["file:37","instruction"]},{"requirement_id":"R013","criterion_index":1,"verdict":"insufficient","basis":"runtime","rationale":"Hud.gd _update_markers draws one ColorRect per ghost, colored identically (all amber 0.61,0.48,1.0) rather than 'distinct' colors, contradicting the art-manifest integration note. No visual check performed.","evidence_ids":[],"source_ids":["file:35"]},{"requirement_id":"R013","criterion_index":2,"verdict":"insufficient","basis":"runtime","rationale":"The behavior at the fourth loop is 'drop oldest ghost'; that the 'defined maximum-loop reset behavior' (or the instructor's intent) is an exact match is not confirmed. No snapshot captured a fourth-loop overflow moment.","evidence_ids":[],"source_ids":["file:37"]},{"requirement_id":"R014","criterion_index":0,"verdict":"insufficient","basis":"runtime","rationale":"Timeline node exists with a 1248-px track and is labeled 0-30s in code, but the visible association of scale 0-30s and 'bar' affordance was not observed; per protocol, visual confirmation needed.","evidence_ids":[],"source_ids":["file:28","snapshot:near_rewind_probe-capture:240"]},{"requirement_id":"R014","criterion_index":1,"verdict":"insufficient","basis":"runtime","rationale":"Marker nodes created but all share the same color; distinct markers per ghost not observed, and marker position is same for all ghosts because it uses level loop_time rather than ghost playback_frame.","evidence_ids":[],"source_ids":["file:35","snapshot:near_rewind_probe-capture:240"]},{"requirement_id":"R014","criterion_index":2,"verdict":"fail","basis":"runtime","rationale":"Hud.gd _update_markers uses loop_time (current loop tick/30) for all markers, so markers do not reflect each ghost's playback_frame; all three ghosts at frame 240 show playback_frame=60 and marker position is identical. This is a missed test, not a broken behavior.","evidence_ids":[],"source_ids":["snapshot:near_victory_probe-capture:599"]},{"requirement_id":"R016","criterion_index":0,"verdict":"pass","basis":"runtime","rationale":"Snapshot:near_rewind_probe-capture:0 shows HUD/Root/ResetButton with text 'Reset', visible and enabled.","evidence_ids":["player-0001-play-04"],"source_ids":["snapshot:near_rewind_probe-capture:0"]},{"requirement_id":"R016","criterion_index":1,"verdict":"insufficient","basis":"runtime","rationale":"Reset button press was not tested; reset_ghosts code exists but is not exercised by any played trace in the current evidence.","evidence_ids":[],"source_ids":["file:37","file:35"]},{"requirement_id":"R016","criterion_index":2,"verdict":"insufficient","basis":"runtime","rationale":"reset_ghosts sets tick=0 and calls player.respawn() but its acceptance - a fresh 30 s timer and no retained loop replay - was not observed.","evidence_ids":[],"source_ids":["file:37"]},{"requirement_id":"R017","criterion_index":0,"verdict":"insufficient","basis":"runtime","rationale":"CompleteOverlay exists with a 'Loops used: 1' placeholder but the overlay was only ever hidden in observed sessions; full display of an actual loops-used integer was not captured.","evidence_ids":[],"source_ids":["file:28","snapshot:near_victory_probe-capture:599"]},{"requirement_id":"R017","criterion_index":1,"verdict":"insufficient","basis":"runtime","rationale":"Exit time within the final loop was not displayed because completion did not fire.","evidence_ids":[],"source_ids":["snapshot:near_victory_probe-capture:599"]},{"requirement_id":"R017","criterion_index":2,"verdict":"insufficient","basis":"runtime","rationale":"No observed completion, so displayed values were not compared against actual loop count/exit timestamp.
